title: MOM CONFRONTS MCDONALD'S, DRIVE-THRU GUY ROASTS
topic: MOM CONFRONTS MCDONALD'S, DRIVE-THRU GUY ROASTS
caption:
Jo's mom storms McDonald's to get his job back; 30 seconds later she emerges victorious. The drive-thru guy sees Jo and deadpans, 'I see him as a nugget.' From
Blue in the Face, on Netflix

clip.why: Mom's 30-second nuclear intervention capped by drive-thru worker's perfect one-liner.
clip.creator: Jo Koy: Comedy Special
